## Entities

### my.catalog.Products

Product sold in the catalog. Labels and validations: srv/annotations/Products.cds

Description (`CatalogService.Products`): Product sold in the catalog, created and changed through a draft.

Aspects: cuid, managed. Keys: ID. Projections: CatalogService.Products.

| Element | Type | Title (en) | Description | Annotations |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ID | UUID(36) |  |  | key |
| createdAt | Timestamp | Created On |  | @readonly, computed |
| createdBy | String(255) | Created By |  | @readonly, computed |
| modifiedAt | Timestamp | Changed On |  | @readonly, computed |
| modifiedBy | String(255) | Changed By |  | @readonly, computed |
| name | String(100) | Product Name | Name of the product. | @mandatory |
| description | String(500) | Description | Free-text description of the product. |  |
| price | Decimal(15, 2) | Price | Unit price of the product in its currency. | @mandatory, @Measures.ISOCurrency: currency_code, @assert.range: [0,99999999.99] |
| currency | Association to sap.common.Currencies | Currency | Currency of the price. | @mandatory, @assert.target: true |
| currency_code | String(3) | Currency |  | @mandatory, @assert.target: true |
| stock | Integer | Stock Quantity | Number of units in stock. | @mandatory, @assert.range: [0,1000000] |
| rating | Integer | Rating | Customer rating on a scale of 0 to 5. | @assert.range: [0,5] |
| category | Association to my.catalog.Categories | Category | Category of the product. | @mandatory, @assert.target: true |
| category_code | String(20) | Category |  | @mandatory, @assert.target: true |
| subcategory | Association to my.catalog.Subcategories | Subcategory | Subcategory of the product, which must belong to the product's category. | @mandatory, @assert.target: true |
| subcategory_code | String(20) | Subcategory |  | @mandatory, @assert.target: true |
| imageUrl | String(500) | Image URL | URL of the product image. |  |
| details | Composition of many my.catalog.ProductDetails | Details | Detail rows of the product, one per attribute assigned to its subcategory. |  |

### my.catalog.ProductDetails

Detail row of a product: an attribute and its typed value (ADR-0027). The column used depends on
the attribute's value type; MULTI_LIST values are the selections. Rows are created by the draft
handler. Labels and rules: srv/annotations/ProductDetails.cds

Description (`CatalogService.ProductDetails`): Detail row of a product: one attribute and its typed value, written only through the product's draft.

Aspects: cuid. Keys: ID. Projections: CatalogService.ProductDetails.

| Element | Type | Title (en) | Description | Annotations |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ID | UUID(36) |  |  | key |
| product | Association to my.catalog.Products | Product | Product the detail row belongs to. |  |
| product_ID | UUID(36) | Product |  |  |
| attribute | Association to my.catalog.DetailAttributes | Attribute | Attribute of the row, assigned to the product's subcategory and used once per product. | @mandatory, @assert.target: true |
| attribute_code | String(30) | Attribute |  | @mandatory, @assert.target: true |
| position | Integer | Position | Display order of the row, taken from the attribute's position in the subcategory. | @readonly, computed |
| textValue | String(100) | Text Value | Value of a TEXT attribute. |  |
| numberValue | Decimal(15, 3) | Number Value | Value of an INTEGER or DECIMAL attribute, within the attribute's minimum and maximum. |  |
| listValue | Association to my.catalog.DetailListValues | List Value | Value of a LIST attribute, one of the attribute's list values. | @assert.target: true |
| listValue_code | String(30) | List Value |  | @assert.target: true |
| selections | Composition of many my.catalog.ProductDetailSelections |  | Selected values of a MULTI_LIST attribute. |  |

### my.catalog.DetailAttributes

Detail attribute with its unit and value type, reusable across subcategories (ADR-0026, ADR-0027).
minValue and maxValue bound numeric values, scale is the decimals of a DECIMAL attribute;
values is the list of a LIST or MULTI_LIST attribute. Labels: srv/annotations/DetailAttributes.cds

Description (`CatalogService.DetailAttributes`): Characteristic a product can carry, with its value type, unit and limits, a read-only code list.

Aspects: sap.common.CodeList. Keys: code. Projections: CatalogService.DetailAttributes.

| Element | Type | Title (en) | Description | Annotations |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name | String(255) | Name | Name of the attribute in the user's language. |  |
| descr | String(1000) | Description | Description of the attribute in the user's language. |  |
| code | String(30) | Attribute | Code of the attribute. | key |
| unit | String(10) | Unit | Unit of measure of the attribute's value. |  |
| valueType | Association to my.catalog.DetailValueTypes | Value Type | Value type that decides which value column of a detail row holds the value. |  |
| valueType_code | String(20) | Value Type |  |  |
| minValue | Decimal(15, 3) | Minimum Value | Lowest allowed value of an INTEGER or DECIMAL attribute. |  |
| maxValue | Decimal(15, 3) | Maximum Value | Highest allowed value of an INTEGER or DECIMAL attribute. |  |
| scale | Integer | Decimal Places | Number of decimal places of a DECIMAL attribute. |  |
| subcategories | Association to many my.catalog.SubcategoryAttributes |  | Subcategory assignments of the attribute. |  |
| values | Association to many my.catalog.DetailListValues |  | Allowed values of a LIST or MULTI_LIST attribute. |  |
| texts | Composition of many my.catalog.DetailAttributes.texts |  |  |  |
| localized | Association to my.catalog.DetailAttributes.texts |  |  |  |

## Reusable aspects from @sap/cds/common

`cuid` (key ID : UUID), `managed` (createdAt, createdBy, modifiedAt, modifiedBy), `temporal`, `Currency`, `Country`, `Language`, `sap.common.CodeList`. Use them, not your own copies.
